plan.title: Module 11: PR, Review, and Actual Completion

narratives.Description: Deliver Module 11 as a command-free fixed-state exercise that teaches learners to review a fictional change before a PR, classify every supplied finding before editing, and prepare one coherent fix batch. The same independently buildable story teaches evidence-bounded completion claims without a live repository, review bot, Greptile signal, deployment, or UAT run.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
Revalidate the immutable Directive 0.112.0 pre-PR, review-cycle, coding-review, and lifecycle sources, then write focused negative tests in scripts/verify-module-11.test.mjs for the fixed packet, finding classification, fix-batch, and completion-state contracts.
Author curriculum/modules/11-review-and-completion.md and solutions/module-11-review-and-completion.md, implement scripts/verify-module-11.mjs, and update the exact learner navigation, source, package-script, verifier, and xBRIEF paths listed in file_scope.
Run npm run check:module-11, npm run test:module-11, and directive verify:vbrief-conformance --project-root . before the separate task deft:check aggregate gate, retaining the first failure and final evidence without weakening any verifier.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer learning Directive, I want to classify review findings and completion evidence before acting, so that I can resolve blocking work coherently and state only what the evidence proves.

clauses.text: The source record identifies immutable Directive 0.112.0 pre-PR, review, and lifecycle evidence, labels authoring-runtime drift explicitly, and contains no Greptile or live-host dependency.
The fixed fictional packet records a complete zero-change pre-PR cycle and requires every finding to be classified by severity, scope, blocking status, disposition, and evidence before editing.
The explained resolution fixes only blocking in-scope findings in one coherent batch, records P2 and out-of-scope dispositions, and requires current-head re-review without one push per finding.
Completion scenarios preserve implemented, PR-open, merge-ready, integration-merged, delivered, deployed, and UAT-verified evidence without inferring deployment or UAT from Git state.
Focused and negative tests enforce review order, severity, scope, batching, current-head evidence, lifecycle, navigation, source, and still-planned capstone boundaries.
